## [CN]双击选中的 Tab
## [EN]Double tap on the selected tab

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 快速（`CYLTabBarItemDoubleTapInterval`，0.3 秒内）连续两次点击当前选中的 Tab 时回调，常用于列表回到顶部并刷新。只统计对已选中 Tab 的点击，选中 Tab 的那一次点击不计入；PlusButton 不参与。两种写法：在该 Tab 的 `tabBarItem` 上设置 block，或实现代理方法。 | Called when the user taps the selected tab twice quickly (within `CYLTabBarItemDoubleTapInterval`, 0.3 s), typically to scroll a list to the top and refresh it. Only taps on a tab that is already selected count; the tap that selects a tab does not; the plus button never does. Two ways: a block on the tab's `tabBarItem`, or a delegate method. |

```Objective-C
// Block: on the tab's item (the navigation controller's tabBarItem; the root view controller's also works).
__weak __typeof(self) weakSelf = self;
self.navigationController.tabBarItem.cyl_doubleTapBlock = ^(UITabBarItem *tabBarItem, NSInteger index) {
    [weakSelf.tableView setContentOffset:CGPointZero animated:YES];
    [weakSelf.tableView.mj_header beginRefreshing];
};

// Delegate: CYLTabBarControllerDelegate.
- (void)tabBarController:(CYLTabBarController *)tabBarController didDoubleTapViewController:(UIViewController *)viewController atIndex:(NSUInteger)index {
}
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 实现方式：系统 TabBar（液态玻璃、经典样式）与扁平样式 TabBar 的每次点击都会在选中状态改变之前调用 `-[CYLTabBarController tabBar:didSelectItem:]`，在这里判断点击的是否为已选中的 Tab。重写该方法的子类请调用 super。演示：ObjC 示例首页，双击“首页” Tab 回到顶部并刷新。 | How: every tap of the system tab bar (Liquid Glass, classic) and of the flat design tab bar reaches `-[CYLTabBarController tabBar:didSelectItem:]` before the selection changes, where the tap on an already selected tab is detected. A subclass that overrides that method calls super. Demo: the ObjC example's home page: double tap the Home tab to scroll to the top and refresh. |

## [CN]一次设置所有布局的 item 样式
## [EN]Item styles for every layout in one go

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| `UITabBarAppearance` 分别为纵向排列（iPhone 竖屏）、横向排列（iPad、横屏）与紧凑横向排列保存 item 样式，只设置 `stackedLayoutAppearance` 时，横屏或 iPad 上样式会失效。`-cyl_applyItemAppearanceWithBlock:` 对三者依次执行同一个 block。 | `UITabBarAppearance` keeps item styles separately for stacked (iPhone portrait), inline (iPad, landscape) and compact inline items; setting only `stackedLayoutAppearance` loses the style in landscape or on iPad. `-cyl_applyItemAppearanceWithBlock:` runs one block on all three. |

```Objective-C
UITabBarAppearance *appearance = [[UITabBarAppearance alloc] init];
[appearance cyl_applyItemAppearanceWithBlock:^(UITabBarItemAppearance *itemAppearance) {
    itemAppearance.selected.iconColor = UIColor.systemRedColor;
    itemAppearance.selected.titleTextAttributes = @{ NSForegroundColorAttributeName : UIColor.systemRedColor };
}];
tabBarController.tabBar.standardAppearance = appearance;
```

## [CN]经典样式接口与 UITabBarAppearance 同时生效
## [EN]Classic styles and UITabBarAppearance together

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| iOS 13 起，TabBar 一旦使用 `UITabBarAppearance`（任何 `standardAppearance = ...`），UIKit 就会忽略 `tintColor`、`barTintColor`、`unselectedItemTintColor`、`backgroundImage`、`shadowImage`、`barStyle`，常见表现是“设置了选中颜色 / 分割线 / 背景色却没有效果”。`CYLTabBar` 的这些 setter 现在会同时把值写入 `standardAppearance`（存在 `scrollEdgeAppearance` 时也写入），两种设置方式可以同时使用。只写入发生变化的值；液态玻璃（由系统绘制 TabBar）时不同步；`syncsClassicStylesToAppearance = NO` 可关闭。只作用于本库的 `CYLTabBar`（子类重写），不 hook 全局的 `UITabBar`，因此不会影响 App 中的其他 TabBar。 | Since iOS 13, once a tab bar uses `UITabBarAppearance` (any `standardAppearance = ...`), UIKit ignores `tintColor`, `barTintColor`, `unselectedItemTintColor`, `backgroundImage`, `shadowImage` and `barStyle`: "the selected color / the separator / the background color has no effect". `CYLTabBar`'s setters now also write their value into `standardAppearance` (and `scrollEdgeAppearance` when there is one), so both ways of styling work together. Only a value that changed is written; not with Liquid Glass (the system draws the bar); `syncsClassicStylesToAppearance = NO` turns it off. It only concerns the library's `CYLTabBar` (overrides in the subclass), no global `UITabBar` method is hooked, so the app's other tab bars are untouched. |

```Objective-C
tabBarController.tabBar.standardAppearance = appearance;   // the app uses UITabBarAppearance...
tabBarController.tabBar.tintColor = UIColor.systemRedColor; // ...and this still works now
tabBarController.tabBar.shadowImage = [UIImage new];        // the separator line goes away
```

## [CN]背景视图、阴影线与模糊效果
## [EN]Background views, the shadow line and the blur

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 任意 `UITabBar` 新增 `cyl_backgroundView`（承载背景、模糊与阴影线的视图）、`cyl_shadowImageView`（顶部阴影线）、`cyl_effectViews` / `cyl_effectView`（模糊视图），以及可读写的 `cyl_backgroundEffect`（模糊样式）与 `cyl_effectForegroundColor`（叠在模糊上的颜色）。iOS 13+ 二者写入 `UITabBarAppearance`（公开接口），因此重新布局后不会被系统覆盖，扁平样式也随之更新；iOS 13 以前直接设置在模糊视图上。 | Every `UITabBar` gets `cyl_backgroundView` (the view that holds the background, the blur and the shadow line), `cyl_shadowImageView` (the line on top), `cyl_effectViews` / `cyl_effectView` (the blur views), and the read-write `cyl_backgroundEffect` (the blur) and `cyl_effectForegroundColor` (a color over the blur). On iOS 13+ both are written into `UITabBarAppearance` (public API), so the system does not overwrite them on the next layout and FlatDesign follows; before iOS 13 they are set on the blur views. |

```Objective-C
tabBarController.tabBar.cyl_backgroundEffect = [UIBlurEffect effectWithStyle:UIBlurEffectStyleSystemThinMaterialDark];
tabBarController.tabBar.cyl_effectForegroundColor = [UIColor.systemPinkColor colorWithAlphaComponent:0.15];
tabBarController.tabBar.cyl_shadowImageView.hidden = YES;
```

## [CN]TabBar 占用的高度
## [EN]The height the tab bar covers

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| `-[UIViewController cyl_tabBarSpacingInViewCoordinator]`：TabBar 遮挡 `self.view` 底部的高度（`self.view` 坐标系），用于在 TabBar 上方放置悬浮按钮、底部工具条等。没有 TabBar、TabBar 隐藏或本页面隐藏 TabBar（`hidesBottomBarWhenPushed`）时为 0。适用于系统 TabBar（液态玻璃的悬浮 TabBar 也包含其下方的间距）与扁平样式自己的 TabBar。需要视图已在 window 上，请在 `-viewDidLayoutSubviews` 或 `-viewWillAppear:` 中使用。 | `-[UIViewController cyl_tabBarSpacingInViewCoordinator]`: how much of the bottom of `self.view` the tab bar covers, in `self.view`'s points, for placing a floating button or a bottom toolbar above it. 0 when there is no tab bar, it is hidden, or this page hides it (`hidesBottomBarWhenPushed`). Works with the system tab bar (for the floating Liquid Glass bar it includes the margin below it) and FlatDesign's own bar. The view must be in a window: use it in `-viewDidLayoutSubviews` or `-viewWillAppear:`. |

```Objective-C
- (void)viewDidLayoutSubviews {
    [super viewDidLayoutSubviews];
    CGFloat bottom = self.cyl_tabBarSpacingInViewCoordinator ?: self.view.safeAreaInsets.bottom;
    self.floatingButton.center = CGPointMake(CGRectGetMaxX(self.view.bounds) - 44, CGRectGetMaxY(self.view.bounds) - bottom - 44);
}
```

## [CN]屏幕方向、Home Indicator 与边缘手势
## [EN]Orientation, the home indicator and edge gestures

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| `CYLTabBarController` 的 `supportedInterfaceOrientations` 与 `shouldAutorotate` 现在先询问由它 present 出的控制器（正在 dismiss 时除外），例如系统全屏视频播放器，竖屏 App 中的视频因此可以横屏；`UIAlertController` 不参与，避免它反过来询问 presenting 控制器造成循环。没有 present 时与之前一样由选中 Tab（导航栈栈顶）决定。`prefersHomeIndicatorAutoHidden` 与 `preferredScreenEdgesDeferringSystemGestures` 交给选中的 Tab 决定（全屏视频、游戏页面可隐藏 Home Indicator）。 | `CYLTabBarController`'s `supportedInterfaceOrientations` and `shouldAutorotate` now ask the view controller it presents first (unless it is being dismissed), e.g. the system's full screen video player, so a video can turn to landscape in a portrait app; a `UIAlertController` is left out, since it asks its presenting view controller back and would loop. Without a presented one, the selected tab (the top of its navigation stack) decides, as before. `prefersHomeIndicatorAutoHidden` and `preferredScreenEdgesDeferringSystemGestures` are left to the selected tab (a full screen video or a game page can hide the home indicator). |

## [CN]iOS 13、14 上粗体或大字号标题被截断
## [EN]Bold or large titles cut off on iOS 13 and 14

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| iOS 13、14 的 UIKit bug：通过 `UITabBarAppearance` 把 Tab 标题设为大于默认字号（iOS 13）或粗体（iOS 13、14）时，标题仍按默认字体的宽度布局，显示为“我…”。`CYLTabBar` 在 UIKit 布局之后，把宽度不足的标题以原中心加宽到合适宽度（不超过按钮宽度）。iOS 15 起系统已修复，不做处理。无需任何代码。 | UIKit bug on iOS 13 and 14: a tab title made larger than the default (iOS 13) or bold (iOS 13 and 14) through `UITabBarAppearance` keeps the width of the default font and shows as "Mi…". After UIKit's layout, `CYLTabBar` widens such a title to fit (at most the button's width) around the same center. Fixed by Apple in iOS 15, so nothing is done there. No code needed. |

## [CN]Tab 按钮布局后的回调
## [EN]A callback after the tab button is laid out

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| `-[UITabBarItem cyl_viewDidLayoutSubviewsBlock]`：TabBar 每次布局之后执行，参数为 UIKit 为该 item 绘制的按钮，适合在按钮上添加或摆放自己的视图（例如自定义角标、装饰图），避免被 UIKit 的布局移动或遮挡。UIKit 重建按钮后（例如修改了 item 的图片）可能是新的按钮，因此每次都请重新查找子视图。适用于系统 TabBar（液态玻璃、经典样式）；扁平样式的 item 是本库自己的视图。 | `-[UITabBarItem cyl_viewDidLayoutSubviewsBlock]`: runs after every layout of the tab bar with the button UIKit draws for this item, to add or place a view of your own on it (a custom badge, a decoration) that UIKit's layout would otherwise move or cover. UIKit may build a new button (e.g. after the item's image changed), so look subviews up again each time. The system tab bar (Liquid Glass, classic); FlatDesign items are the library's own views. |

```Objective-C
viewController.tabBarItem.cyl_viewDidLayoutSubviewsBlock = ^(UITabBarItem *tabBarItem, UIView *view) {
    UIView *ribbon = [view viewWithTag:2026] ?: ({
        UIView *newRibbon = [[UIView alloc] initWithFrame:CGRectMake(0, 0, 18, 4)];
        newRibbon.tag = 2026;
        newRibbon.backgroundColor = UIColor.systemRedColor;
        [view addSubview:newRibbon];
        newRibbon;
    });
    ribbon.center = CGPointMake(CGRectGetMidX(view.bounds), CGRectGetMaxY(view.bounds) - 3);
};
```
